description: This source file defines a Java class 'DataIntegrityErrorHandler' responsible for handling data integrity issues within the Apache Fineract project. The class provides a method to process exceptions related to data integrity, specifically identifying duplicate external IDs and logging/error handling for other issues.

classes.name: DataIntegrityErrorHandler
classes.description: Handler for managing data integrity exceptions, particularly dealing with duplicate external IDs and logging errors.

methods.name: handleDataIntegrityIssues
methods.description: Processes data integrity exceptions, throws a specific exception if a duplicate external ID is detected, or logs and raises a generic data integrity issue otherwise.
